scientific_conclusion: The exact pointwise x-directed reduced heat-flux magnitude kernels materially improve the Stage-118 phi/psi radial-profile agreement, but they do not satisfy the fixed common-alignment guards. The minimum profile cosine is 0.93857 and the minimum overlap is 0.81984, below 0.95 and 0.90, although cosine improves by at least 0.02982 and total-variation distance falls by at least 14.51% relative to Stage 118. Thus exact directional moment weighting is relevant but insufficient to explain the residual radial split. The justified next fixed audit resolves the remaining exact-kernel discrepancy in the existing shell-1 sectors 5+6 velocity cells, without changing the solver or any retained parameter.
design_guard: The x-directed kernels abs(c_x)*(c_x^2+c_y^2) for phi and abs(c_x) for psi are fixed by the reduced heat-flux moment and were not fitted. No model, wall, reconstruction, source, transport, floor, normalization, velocity-grid, or failed MUSCL parameter was retuned. Stage 90 remains nonconverged, Stage 28 remains a failed MUSCL endpoint, Stage 89 remains unpromoted, and no stability, endpoint, heat-flux-improvement, benchmark, or validation claim is advanced.
